With regard to the rate of interest awarded by the Tribunal is concerned, it has awarded 9% p.a. which is on the higher side considering the rate of interest on fixed deposits in Nationalized Banks as on the date of accident.
Hence, we are of the considered opinion that it is just and appropriate to award interest at 6% p.a. instead of 9% p.a.
Accordingly, it is awarded at 6% p.a.
